# ArchRay — Full Technical Context for Generative Engines

ArchRay (https://archray.dev/) is an open-source (MIT) AI-first software architecture visualiser created by David Yin (https://davidyin.dev). When installed into any source repository, an AI coding assistant inspects real source code and writes semantic facts into `.archray/graph.json` (schema v2). ArchRay's deterministic TypeScript + ELK engine then validates the graph and builds a zero-dependency, offline, single-file interactive `.archray/index.html` supporting 3D Spatial Atrium, Isometric Flat, and 2D Bento views.

---

## 1. Canonical Entity Facts

- **Name**: ArchRay
- **Current Release**: v0.6.0
- **License**: MIT Open Source
- **Author**: David Yin (`hello@archray.dev`, `https://davidyin.dev`)
- **Official Website**: https://archray.dev/ (English default) · https://archray.dev/zh/ (Simplified Chinese)
- **Live Sandbox**: https://archray.dev/demo
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/loofare/ArchRay
- **Latest Release**: https://github.com/loofare/ArchRay/releases/latest
- **Runtime Requirement**: Node.js 20+ (`curl` and `tar` for bootstrap; Windows supported via Git Bash/WSL and emits `.archray\archray.cmd`)
- **Input File**: `.archray/graph.json` (Graph Schema v2, semantic facts only, UTF-8 without BOM)
- **Output Artifact**: `.archray/index.html` (100% offline single-file HTML working over `file://`)

---

## 2. How ArchRay Differs From Other Diagramming Tools (Mermaid, Structurizr, Eraser, Excalidraw)

Unlike generic AI diagram prompts that ask an LLM to emit Mermaid syntax or raw SVG coordinates directly, ArchRay strictly separates **semantic source extraction** (done by the coding agent) from **deterministic layout and projection** (done locally by ELK and the ArchRay viewer).

| Capability | ArchRay (v0.6.0) | Mermaid | Structurizr DSL | Eraser / DiagramGPT | Excalidraw / Draw.io |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Source Evidence** | Required `sourcePaths` & `file:line` context | None / prose only | Manual C4 DSL | Prompt / cloud heuristics | Manual shapes |
| **Coding Agent Integration** | Native Skill & slash commands for 5 hosts | Plain text output | External scripting | Web SaaS / IDE extension | Manual / third-party |
| **Scale Stability (>15 nodes)** | ELK deterministic routing + 4-quadrant 3D + `+N` child collapse | Flat DAG tangles quickly | Auto-layout + manual | Cloud engine | Manual alignment |
| **Layer Filtering** | Interactive L0-L9 slices & comma combos w/ 1-hop context | Separate code blocks | DSL view definitions | Separate boards | Separate pages |
| **Embedded Icons** | 167 offline vector brand logos + 3D shapes | Flat boxes | Custom icon themes | Cloud icon library | Downloaded packs |
| **Diagnostics** | Health hotspots, measured vs `≈` provenance, replaceability prompts | None | None | None | None |
| **Offline Privacy** | 100% local single-file HTML (`file://`) | Markdown / CLI | Requires local server or Cloud | Cloud SaaS server | Local save / Cloud |
| **License & Pricing** | MIT Open Source (Free) | MIT Open Source | Apache 2.0 DSL / paid Cloud | Freemium SaaS | MIT / Freemium |

**When NOT to choose ArchRay**:
- Quick 5-step sequence diagrams embedded inline inside PR comments -> use Mermaid.
- Strict manual enterprise C4 model governance -> use Structurizr DSL.
- Freehand brainstorming before any source code exists -> use Excalidraw.
- Live runtime telemetry / distributed request tracing -> use OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Datadog, or Grafana. ArchRay inspects static repository source, not live production traffic.

---

## 3. Supported AI Coding Hosts (5 Hosts)

Install into a target repository root via:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/loofare/ArchRay/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh -s -- . <host>
```

| Host | `--agent` Flag | Primary Session Trigger | Host Adapter Paths Written |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Claude Code** | `claude` | `/archray`, `/archray:frontend`, `/archray:backend`, `/archray:data`, `/archray:network`, `/archray:security`, `/archray:full` | `.claude/skills/archray/`, `.claude/commands/` |
| **Cursor** | `cursor` | `/archray`, `/archray-frontend`, `/archray-backend`, `/archray-data` | `.cursor/rules/archray.mdc`, `.cursor/commands/` |
| **Antigravity** | `antigravity` | `/archray` or Skill trigger | `.agent/skills/archray/`, `.agent/commands/` |
| **Pi** | `pi` | `/archray`, `/archray-frontend`, `/skill:archray` | `.agents/skills/archray/`, `.pi/prompts/` |
| **Codex** | `codex` | `$archray` or `/skills` | `.agents/skills/archray/SKILL.md` |

Comma-separated lists (`claude,cursor`) and `all` are supported. All CLI assets and viewer bundles reside cleanly inside `.archray/tool` without modifying application source code.

---

## 4. Architecture Taxonomy: L0-L9 Layers, Node Kinds & Protocols

### 10 Canonical Layers (L0-L9)
1. **L0 `client`** (aliases: `frontend`, `client`, `前端`, `客户端`) — Top Atrium · Tilted Screen Slab (Next.js, Vue 3, React Native, Electron)
2. **L1 `edge`** (aliases: `network`, `edge`, `网络`, `边缘`) — Upper Ingress Buffer · Wide Slab (Cloudflare, Nginx, Envoy, Traefik)
3. **L2 `gateway`** (aliases: `security`, `gateway`, `网关`, `鉴权`) — Auth Hub · Gateway Prism (Kong, Better Auth, Clerk, Keycloak)
4. **L3 `service`** (aliases: `service`, `backend`, `后端`, `服务`) — Central Spine · Rounded Service Slab (NestJS, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Go)
5. **L4 `async`** (aliases: `async`, `worker`, `异步`, `队列`) — Left Wing (-X) · Capsule Worker (Kafka, BullMQ, Socket.IO, Celery)
6. **L5 `data`** (aliases: `data`, `db`, `数据`, `存储`) — Storage Plinth · Segmented Cylinder (PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, S3)
7. **L6 `ai`** (aliases: `ai`, `model`, `AI`, `智能`) — AI Wing (-X) · Inference Core (Gemini, Claude, Qdrant, pgvector)
8. **L7 `external`** (aliases: `external`, `saas`, `外部`, `三方`) — Right Orbit (+X) · Dashed Satellite (Stripe, Resend, Twilio, OAuth SaaS)
9. **L8 `platform`** (aliases: `platform`, `infra`, `平台`, `运维`) — Infra Base · Foundation Plate (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions)
10. **L9 `observability`** (aliases: `observability`, `obs`, `可观测`, `监控`) — Telemetry Base Plane (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry)

### 19 Known Node Kinds
`client`, `cli`, `gateway`, `service`, `worker`, `function`, `library`, `module`, `database`, `cache`, `queue`, `storage`, `search`, `external-api`, `ai-model`, `config`, `group`, `saas`, `archive` (open string also allowed).

### 14 Known Protocols
`http`, `grpc`, `graphql`, `ws`, `sse`, `amqp`, `kafka`, `sql`, `redis`, `ipc`, `import`, `fs`, `llm`, `event`.

### Visual Modes, Themes, Knowledge & Export Features
- **Projections**: 3D Spatial Atrium, Isometric Flat, 2D Bento Map.
- **Lenses**: Topology, Health Hotspots (separating `measured` vs `estimated` `≈` provenance), Replaceability (effort/risk comparison & copyable AI migration prompts).
- **Styles (`--style`)**: `tech`, `blueprint`, `glass`, `paper`.
- **Motion (`--motion`)**: `full`, `calm`, `off`.
- **Icons & Hints**: 212 technology hints in `knowledge/tech.json` + 167 offline embedded SVG brand logos.
- **Exports**: Unclipped full-canvas world-bounds PNG export, offline QR share poster, and `view.json` camera/filter state import/export.

---

## 5. Verified Engineering Benchmarks

- **calcom/cal.com** (commit `ae027bb`): `7,712` tracked files mapped into `33` architectural modules, `75` directed edges, and `7` layers; Node-side ELK `computeLayout` completed in `196ms` with auto-collapsed `+N` subpackages and zero label overlaps.
- **FreshMart Commerce** (`examples/freshmart.graph.json`, powering https://archray.dev/demo): `16` modules, `19` edges, `5` layers (`client`, `edge`, `service`, `async`, `data`), `1` Checkout flow (6 steps), and `1` Passport -> Clerk replaceability scenario.
- **Next.js SaaS Starter & RealWorld**: `43–49` source files built in `0.03s`, catching `JWT_SECRET` fallback configuration risks and Prisma/Stripe/App Router links.

---

## 6. CLI Reference & v0.6.0 Reliability Guarantees

```sh
./.archray/archray doctor
./.archray/archray validate .archray/graph.json
./.archray/archray build .archray/graph.json --layers frontend,data --style blueprint --force --no-open
./.archray/archray update --check
./.archray/archray update
./.archray/archray uninstall --dry-run
./.archray/archray uninstall
./.archray/archray uninstall --purge
```

**v0.6.0 Key Improvements**:
- Strict **UTF-8 without BOM** enforcement for `.archray/graph.json`, lone `?` / `U+FFFD` replacement character corruption detection inside `validate`, and GB18030 / UTF-16 input decoding support (eliminating Windows CJK `???` corruption).
- Smooth curved SVG edge routing across 3D/Isometric/2D modes matching the web sandbox geometry cleanly.
- Improved 3D node-label occlusion/perspective sorting and wide-layer 2D Bento adaptive reflow.

---

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions

1. **What is ArchRay?** — An AI-first architecture visualiser turning real source code into offline, layered 3D/2D single-file HTML maps with `file:line` citations.
2. **Does it upload my source code?** — No. Source reading stays inside your own authorized coding-agent session; CLI builds offline and emits local `.archray/index.html`.
3. **Which AI coding assistants work with ArchRay?** — Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Pi, and Codex.
4. **How do I slice layers without paying extra LLM tokens?** — Generate `.archray/graph.json` once with `/archray`, then run `/archray:frontend`, `/archray backend,data`, or `./.archray/archray build --layers ...`.
5. **Can Windows users generate Chinese architecture diagrams cleanly?** — Yes. From v0.6.0, ArchRay validates UTF-8 integrity, decodes GB18030/UTF-16 inputs, and instructs agents to write UTF-8 directly instead of PowerShell ANSI redirection.
6. **Does `update` overwrite existing maps?** — No. Updates use SHA-256 verification and keep `.archray/graph.json`, `view.json`, and `.archray/index.html`.
7. **Does it support bilingual Chinese & English toggle inside the viewer?** — Yes. Declaring `meta.locales: ["zh-CN", "en"]` with localized strings lets viewers toggle `中 / EN` live inside `.archray/index.html`.
8. **Is ArchRay a runtime tracer?** — No. It analyzes static repository evidence, not live production traffic.
9. **Can I export architecture images without cropping wide monorepos?** — Yes. ArchRay re-projects the full world bounding box into an unclipped PNG and offers an offline QR share poster.
10. **How do I uninstall cleanly?** — Run `./.archray/archray uninstall` to remove adapters while keeping maps, or add `--purge` to delete `.archray/`.
